水浒

出版说明
《水浒》是我国的一部古典文学名著。为了满足广大读者的需要，我们把它编绘成连环画册。在编绘上尽量保持原著故事情节，但是为了适合用连环画来表现，个别情节也作了一些删节和改动。
全部画册分为三十集，每集有比较完整的故事，可以独自成章；同时，每集内容上下衔接，以便连续阅读。为了阅读方便，每集开头写有内容提要，结尾附有后记，用以交代上集、本集和下集故事大意。
《水浒》连环画，我社1956年—1962年陆续出版过。现在这套连环画，是用原有的文学脚本重新绘制的。
page_text_en:
Black Whirlwind Tears the Edict
Water Margin
No. 24
Publishing Note
"Water Margin" is a classical Chinese literary masterpiece. To meet the needs of a wide readership, we have adapted it into a series of illustrated storybooks. While striving to preserve the original plot, we have made some omissions and modifications to suit the format of illustrated storytelling.
The entire series consists of thirty volumes, each containing a relatively complete story that can stand alone; at the same time, the content of each volume connects with the others for continuous reading. For convenience, each volume begins with a content summary and ends with a postscript, outlining the plot of the previous, current, and next volumes.
The "Water Margin" illustrated series was previously published by our publishing house between 1956 and 1962. This current set has been newly illustrated using the original literary script.

Content Summary
The previous episode, "Yan Qing's Wrestling Match," tells of: Yan Qing disguised as a peddler went to Taian to wrestle, and Li Kui secretly went down the mountain to accompany Yan Qing. Yan Qing outsmarted Ren Yuan. Ren Yuan's disciples fought over the prize, angering Li Kui, who caused a ruckus in Taian.
This episode continues directly from the last: Emperor Huizong Zhao Ji, seeing Liangshan's power grow increasingly strong, became deeply worried and sent Chen Zongshan, the Commander of the Palace Guards, as an imperial envoy to Liangshan to offer amnesty. Cai Jing and Gao Qiu each sent their trusted subordinates along. Song Jiang, upon learning of the imperial amnesty, was extremely delighted; Wu Yong, Lin Chong, Guan Sheng, and others were unwilling to surrender and discussed countermeasures. Wu Yong secretly arranged with the Three Ruan brothers and Li Kui. After the envoy arrived, Ruan Xiaoqi sabotaged the ship to leak water and stole the imperial wine; when the edict was read, Li Kui jumped down from the beam, tore the edict to pieces, and attacked the envoy; when the imperial wine was tasted, the heroes rose in righteous anger and caused a commotion in the Hall of Loyalty and Righteousness. The amnesty failed, Song Jiang escorted the envoy down the mountain, and Wu Yong prepared for battle. The court sent Tong Guan to lead a hundred-thousand-strong army to campaign against Liangshan.
1. Liangshan's power grew increasingly strong, and nearby prefectures and counties submitted memorials to the court.
